name: SK_ID_CURR
description: ID of loan in our sample
shortlist_reason: Identifier, not a feature.

name: TARGET
description: Target variable (1 - client with payment difficulties: he/she had late payment more than X days on at least one of the first Y installments of the loan in our sample, 0 - all other cases)
shortlist_reason: The label.

name: NAME_CONTRACT_TYPE
description: Identification if loan is cash or revolving
shortlist_reason: Cash and revolving loans are different products with different risk (8.33% vs 5.62%).

name: CODE_GENDER
description: Gender of the client
shortlist_reason: Sensitive attribute (M 10.13% vs F 7.01%). Excluded by default because many lenders cannot use gender. Your ruling.

quirks.text: Sensitive attribute. Shown here as a descriptive column only. This project does not use it to make decisions about people, and fairness is out of scope for this phase.

name: FLAG_OWN_CAR
description: Flag if the client owns a car
shortlist_reason: Asset ownership. Owners 7.26% vs non-owners 8.49%. Kept instead of OWN_CAR_AGE (66% structural missing and an unexplained spike).

quirks.text: OWN_CAR_AGE is missing for 100.00% of non-owners.

name: FLAG_OWN_REALTY
description: Flag if client owns a house or flat
shortlist_reason: Near noise: 7.97% vs 8.30% (0.32 pp).

name: CNT_CHILDREN
description: Number of children the client has
shortlist_reason: Weak (range 1.77 pp), max 19, and a family-status attribute.

quirks.text: Largest value 19.

name: AMT_INCOME_TOTAL
description: Income of the client
shortlist_reason: Capacity to repay. Needs a cap or log scale (max 117,000,000).

quirks.text: Largest value 117,000,000 against a median of 148,500 and a 99th percentile of 472,500.

name: AMT_CREDIT
description: Credit amount of the loan
shortlist_reason: Loan size: the exposure. Default rate by decile is hump-shaped, highest in the middle and lowest in the top decile.

name: AMT_ANNUITY
description: Loan annuity
shortlist_reason: Instalment size: what the client must pay each period. Hump-shaped like AMT_CREDIT, and a Spearman of about 0 hides it.

quirks.text: Spearman with TARGET is -0.001, yet decile default rates run from 7.25% up to 10.00% and down to 5.73%.

name: AMT_GOODS_PRICE
description: For consumer loans it is the price of the goods for which the loan is given
shortlist_reason: r = 0.987 with AMT_CREDIT, and an unexplained clump at 450,000 (15,614 rows, 13.67% default). Excluded as a near-duplicate.

quirks.text: 8.46% of rows equal 450,000, with a default rate of 13.67% against 7.56% elsewhere. Cause not verified.

name: NAME_TYPE_SUITE
description: Who was accompanying client when he was applying for the loan
shortlist_reason: Who accompanied the client. Weak (2.55 pp range) and 4 of 8 categories are rare.

name: NAME_INCOME_TYPE
description: Clients income type (businessman, working, maternity leave,...)
shortlist_reason: Source of income. Working 9.52% vs Pensioner 5.40%. Pool the tiny categories (Student, Businessman, Maternity leave, Unemployed).

name: NAME_EDUCATION_TYPE
description: Level of highest education the client achieved
shortlist_reason: Education level, an ordered scale lenders use as an income-stability proxy. 5.42% (higher) to 10.87% (lower secondary).

name: NAME_FAMILY_STATUS
description: Family status of the client
shortlist_reason: Marital status. Single 9.92% vs Widow 5.89%. Sensitive attribute in many jurisdictions (not verified for Home Credit's markets).

quirks.text: Sensitive attribute. Shown here as a descriptive column only. This project does not use it to make decisions about people, and fairness is out of scope for this phase.

name: NAME_HOUSING_TYPE
description: What is the housing situation of the client (renting, living with parents, ...)
shortlist_reason: Housing situation. Rented apartment 12.79% vs Office apartment 6.66%. A standard scorecard item.

name: REGION_POPULATION_RELATIVE
description: Normalized population of region where client lives (higher number means the client lives in more populated region) (Kaggle note: normalized )
shortlist_reason: Urban density of the region. Range 5.31 pp. Only moderately related to the region rating (r about -0.53).

name: DAYS_BIRTH
description: Client's age in days at the time of application (Kaggle note: time only relative to the application)
shortlist_reason: Age. The strongest non-EXT column (Spearman +0.078; younger defaults more). Sensitive attribute: dropping it costs signal, and EXT_SOURCE_1 partly brings it back.
notes: offset in days relative to application (negative = before)

quirks.text: Sensitive attribute. Shown here as a descriptive column only. This project does not use it to make decisions about people, and fairness is out of scope for this phase.

name: DAYS_EMPLOYED
description: How many days before the application the person started current employment (Kaggle note: time only relative to the application)
shortlist_reason: Job tenure, a stability measure. Shorter tenure means higher default. Needs the 365243 placeholder replaced by missing plus a flag.

quirks.text: The value 365243 appears in 33,225 rows (18.01%). They are 33,210 pensioners and 15 unemployed. Default rate 5.41% against 8.66% for other rows.

name: DAYS_REGISTRATION
description: How many days before the application did client change his registration (Kaggle note: time only relative to the application)

notes: offset in days relative to application (negative = before)

name: DAYS_ID_PUBLISH
